name: Dogran's Pendant
summary: Dogran's Pendant draws a succubus toward the warlocks of Orgrimmar. Dogran, a wounded orc, carries it while separated from his mate, Zankaja. In the Cleft of Shadow, warlocks turn the sorrow bound to it into a lure.

sections.title: A Conduit of Heartbreak
sections.body: Dogran's Pendant carries the sorrow of an orc separated from Zankaja. Captivity and crippling wounds have overshadowed their love. The warlocks of the Cleft of Shadow know that demons such as succubi prey on love, yearning, and vulnerability. They use the pendant's grief to draw a succubus across the Twisting Nether and into Neeru Fireblade's summoning circle.

sections.title: Subjugation and Remembrance
sections.body: Under Gan'rul Bloodeye's direction, an aspiring warlock uses the pendant to summon a succubus and subdue it in combat. The trial proves mastery over the demon's seductive manipulations. When the ritual ends, the pendant goes back to Gan'rul, who is to deliver it to Zankaja.

faq.q: What is Dogran's Pendant used for?
aliases: what do i do with dograns pendant
faq.answer: Warlocks use Dogran's Pendant to summon a succubus inside Neeru Fireblade's tent in the Cleft of Shadow. After the demon is summoned and defeated, the pendant goes back to Gan'rul Bloodeye.

faq.q: Why does a succubus respond to the pendant?
faq.answer: A succubus feeds on desire, love, and passion, and knows how to manipulate them. Bound to Dogran and Zankaja's tragic love, the pendant draws the demon across the Nether.

Dogran is an orc whose captivity and injuries are investigated by Horde warlocks through contacts such as Blind Cazul and Ken'zigla. He loves Zankaja but refuses to burden her with caring for an invalid.

faq.q: What happens to the pendant after the summoning ritual?
faq.answer: After the warlock defeats the summoned succubus, the pendant goes back to Gan'rul Bloodeye, who can deliver it to Zankaja.

angles.text: As a Horde warlock, you use Dogran's Pendant to prove mastery over the Nether and learn to summon a succubus.
As a member of the Horde, you can see the pendant's ties to personal tragedies in the Barrens and Durotar, and to the warlock coven in Orgrimmar.
